comment: Every difference between the retained baseline 66ee4657-supplement-v1 and the working tree,
named. `make check-compat` refuses a difference that is not named here and a name here that
matches no difference. A change to this file is a review event.
constructor_additions: a new constructor. Its tag was never held in the baseline.
constructor_retirements: a constructor that left. Its row moved to the retired rows of
tools/Effect4Gen/wire-tags.json at the same tag, and the tag is never given again.
family_additions: a family newly reached from the retained roots.
consumer_additions: a family newly selected by a codec group or by the program world.
vector_removals and vector_migrations: retained byte vectors (paths of
66ee4657/golden-digests.sha256, relative to ocaml/) that no longer exist or changed bytes.
historical_renumbering: the one reuse of tags, from before tags were assigned. At 75d75fdb
`Eff.choose` (tag 23) was removed and the three constructors after it moved down by one,
so `catchIf`, appended earlier at 27, landed on 26. Programs that use `provideLayer`,
`service`, `provideService` or `catchIf` encoded before that commit do not decode to the
same program today. Three retained vectors moved with it and the `choose` vector went.
Since S1 the tags are assigned in tools/Effect4Gen/wire-tags.json and this cannot recur.
The Eff series (DI-79). `branch` retired into `select` under the `bool` decision: tag 15 is
retired, old bytes of a `branch` refuse, and the three retained vectors that held one
(pBranch, pIllBranch, pIllJoin) are the same programs written with `select`.
`yieldError` retired into `fail`, the failure it meant: tag 3 is retired, old bytes refuse,
and pYieldError is the same program written with `fail`.

historical_renumbering.reason: Eff.choose was removed while a tag was a declaration position
